hints.title: What must be equal?
hints.body: The number of each letter must match. Order and positions do not matter.

hints.title: Count one side
hints.body: Build counts for the first string, then subtract counts while scanning the second.

hints.title: Length check first
hints.body: Different lengths cannot match and let you return early.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if lengths differ: return false
counts = empty map
for letter in first: counts[letter] += 1
for letter in second:
    counts[letter] -= 1
    if counts[letter] < 0: return false
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
